name: Write an OpenQASM 3 program using mid-circuit measurement and an if statement to
task_prompt: Write an OpenQASM 3 program using mid-circuit measurement and an if statement to implement active qubit reset followed by an X gate conditioned on the outcome (quantum coin flip + correction), with Python verification via qiskit and AerSimulator. Provide a complete, self-contained program that runs as-is and prints its results.
